title: Figure 19. HFGW Supplemented Remote Terminal Design
description: Diagram of a handheld flip-phone-style remote terminal with a coiled antenna receiving dotted signal lines from four transmitter positions on a wireframe globe labeled (60,-150), (60,120), (-30,-60) and (-30,30). Caption: "Figure 19. HFGW Supplemented Remote Terminal Design". Text below begins section "3.3.1 Improvements Accruing from a HFGW Time Standard".
